text:
Here's a relaxed 3 day Jaipur plan for your parents, with short walks and a cab all three days.

Day 1: Forts and lakes

Amer Fort in the morning, before the crowds and the heat. A jeep ride up saves their knees.
Jal Mahal for a photo stop on the way back.
Hawa Mahal from the outside, then an easy dinner nearby.

Day 2: The old city

City Palace and Jantar Mantar, with a long lunch break in between.
Johari Bazaar for jewellery, textiles and sweets, in the late afternoon.
Birla Mandir at sunset, which is calm and mostly flat.

Day 3: Slow morning, then home

Albert Hall Museum and a gentle stroll around Ram Niwas Garden.
Govind Dev Ji temple for the morning aarti, if they like temples.
Panna Meena ka Kund, or last-minute shopping for blockprint fabrics and lac bangles.

Late October to February is the best weather, so this is a good time to go. Keep days 1 and 2 shorter if either of them tires easily.

Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
9:05 PM

The National Museum (Janpath, New Delhi) is open Tue–Sun, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on Mondays and national holidays. Tickets: adults ₹20 foreign nationals ₹500 and students up to class 12 get in free with an I-card. It opens next on Wed 28 Oct, 10:00 AM. The site's notice says the Arms and Armour, Textiles and Jewellery galleries are closed for renovation. That notice is dated 29 May 2023, so it may be out of date.
